proof.command: read docs/kubernetes.md:3713-3722 beside internal/runtime/sandbox/podkind.go's issuePod.diskSource and claimTemplates

The controller's Sandbox owns its claim, so its pod is the one whose ReadWriteOnce volume must detach from the old node, with the FailedAttachVolume and Multi-Attach events that produces. discoveredComplexity: A scope rule can exclude the very class it was written for. 'Do not flag unchanged code' and 'text a change makes false in a file it owns' look the same until a change rewrites a file without touching the two lines that its behaviour has falsified — and then the first rule hides exactly what the second exists to catch.
